description: Source code for a web-based database visualizer interface, including HTML structure, CSS styles, and JavaScript logic for fetching and displaying database and table data dynamically.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes database list and resets current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database's tables list.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data from a selected table and renders it.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for data table from fetched data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling objects, nulls, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for full display.
